Differential Diagnoses
Pediculosis capitis:
- Seborrhoeic dermatitis
- Pityriasis amiantacea
- Peripilar keratin
- Hair casts
- Piedra
Pediculosis corporis:
- Scabies
- Atopic dermatitis
- All pruritic dermatoses
Pediculosis. pubis:
- Scabies
- Candidiasis
- In the axillae Trichomycosis axillaris
